scope: Release compilation routing through fixed mr-boxington adapter; no CI dispatch, publication, firmware flash or router action in this validation.
pgo: Existing recipe arguments, environment restrictions, generate/use flags and missing-profile warnings remain enforced. Build exec selects only the SHA-verified mbx adapter; plain Cargo remains for version/fetch metadata.
source_binding: New source snapshots execute their snapshotted adapter and compare its SHA against the frozen source map; legacy freezes lacking an adapter use the separately identified current adapter with explicit compatibility metadata.
limits: Canonical x86_64 SDK/PGO ELFs and final firmware are not produced by this focused validation.
Shell/YAML syntax checks were local; Python and actual Rust smoke compilation ran on oracle via mbx.
